intro.title: Medesy Surgical Instruments
intro.description: Premium Italian surgical instruments designed for dental professionals. Each instrument is crafted from surgical-grade stainless steel with precision engineering for optimal clinical performance.

categories.name: Elevators
categories.tagline: Precision dental elevators for luxation and extraction procedures. Available in Heidbrink, Howard, Lussatore, Warwick-James, and Coupland patterns.

products.name: Heidbrink Elevator
products.description: Professional Heidbrink pattern dental elevator for luxation and extraction procedures. Available in straight, left, and right configurations.

products.name: Howard Apical Elevator
products.description: Precision Howard pattern apical elevator for root tip removal and apical surgery. Fine tip for delicate procedures.

products.name: Lussatore Elevator
products.description: Versatile Lussatore dental elevator with straight and curved options in 3.0mm, 4.0mm, and 5.0mm blade widths.

products.name: Warwick-James Elevator
products.description: Classic Warwick-James pattern root elevator with 2.2mm blade. Available in straight, left, and right configurations.

products.name: Coupland Elevator
products.description: Professional Coupland pattern root elevator with multiple blade widths (3.0mm, 3.6mm, 4.2mm) for versatile extraction.

categories.name: Forceps
categories.tagline: Comprehensive extraction forceps series for upper and lower teeth, roots, and specialized procedures. Premium Italian craftsmanship.

products.name: Forceps 2400 Series
products.description: Professional extraction forceps 2400 series for roots, third molars, and specialized extractions.

products.name: Forceps 2500 Series
products.description: Comprehensive extraction forceps 2500 series for molars, roots, and universal applications including cow horn design.

categories.name: Scissors
categories.tagline: Premium surgical scissors for dental and periodontal procedures. Available in Kelly, Goldman-Fox, and Castroviejo patterns.

products.name: Kelly Scissors
products.description: Professional Kelly pattern surgical scissors in straight and curved configurations. 160mm length for general surgical cutting.

products.name: Goldman-Fox Scissors
products.description: Specialized Goldman-Fox pattern scissors designed for periodontal procedures with precision blades.

products.name: Castroviejo Scissors
products.description: Precision Castroviejo pattern micro-scissors for delicate microsurgical and fine procedures.
